newsitem.title: USA: Poore to post charge from unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Poore to post charge from unit sale.

text.p: Poore Brothers Inc said on Wednesday that it will post a second quarter charge of $150,000 from the sale of its distribution business in Texas to Dave Hecht, an independent distributor.

Hecht has purchased certain assets of the business, is licensed to be the company's exclusive distributor of potato chips in Houston, and is restricted from distributing any other brand of kettle chips, Poore Brothers said.
In 1996, the Texas operation accounted for nearly one half of the company's total net loss for the year, despite contributing only 20 percent of the company's revenues, Poore said.
